    Stable bricks from a difference of Hom dimensions #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.stable_image_of_hom_vanishing (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {X Y : FGModuleCat R} (g d : Weight (FGModuleCat R)) (hd : ∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero M → 0 < d.eval M) (hg : ∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), g.eval M = ↑(homFinrank k X M) - ↑(homFinrank k M Y)) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hne : ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (CategoryTheory.Limits.image f)) (hsub : ∀ {L : FGModuleCat R} (i : L ⟶ CategoryTheory.Limits.image f) [CategoryTheory.Mono i], ¬CategoryTheory.IsIso i → ∀ (g : X ⟶ L), g = 0) (hquot : ∀ {Q : FGModuleCat R} (q : CategoryTheory.Limits.image f ⟶ Q) [CategoryTheory.Epi q], ¬CategoryTheory.IsIso q → ∀ (g : Q ⟶ Y), g = 0) :
    (g.corrected d (CategoryTheory.Limits.image f)).IsStable (CategoryTheory.Limits.image f)

    The corrected weight stabilizes the image when proper subobjects and quotients satisfy the two Hom vanishings.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_stable_image_of_hom_difference (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] {X Y : FGModuleCat R} (g d : Weight (FGModuleCat R)) (hd : ∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero M → 0 < d.eval M) (hg : ∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), g.eval M = ↑(homFinrank k X M) - ↑(homFinrank k M Y)) (h : ∃ (f : X ⟶ Y), f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (f : X ⟶ Y), f ≠ 0 ∧ IsBrick (CategoryTheory.Limits.image f) ∧ (g.corrected d (CategoryTheory.Limits.image f)).IsStable (CategoryTheory.Limits.image f)

    If a weight is the difference of the Hom dimensions from X and to Y, a nonzero map from X to Y gives a brick stable at a corrected weight.
